resolution: Confirmed and formalized the model/atlas lifetime invariant against the active editor and package rulings. An unsaved model may hold an ephemeral mesh and atlas during authoring, but neither may claim a filesystem package identity independently. Durable existence begins only at the model package commit point (manifest written last), and first Save must atomically materialize mesh, editable mesh document, atlas if present, and manifest. The current atlas path violates this by calling writeModelArtifacts before first Save, creating orphan-capable package artifacts and weakening the materialization gate. No files changed.
